svg.title: Beam search tree with beam width 2
svg.desc: Starting from a root token, the tree expands into three candidate next words with scores, of which only the top two survive. Each surviving candidate then expands into two more children, and again only the top two overall sequences survive, forming the final beam of two sequences: the cat and a cat.
svg.text: Beam width = 2: at each step, only the top 2 highest-scoring sequences survive
